::: {.publications-header}

<div class="section-label">Publications</div>

<div class="publications-title">Scientific publications</div>

Peer-reviewed articles, book chapters, and other contributions.
</p>

::: {.publications-tools}

<div class="publication-search-wrapper">
<i class="bi bi-search"></i>

<input
  type="search"
  id="publication-search"
  placeholder="Search publications..."
  aria-label="Search publications">
</div>

<select id="publication-type" aria-label="Filter publications by type">
  <option value="all">All publications</option>
  <option value="Research article">Research articles</option>
  <option value="Book chapter">Book chapters</option>
  <option value="Book">Books</option>
</select>

:::

<div id="publication-count"></div>


```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(yaml)

pubs <- yaml::read_yaml("publications.yml")

years <- sort(
  unique(vapply(pubs, function(x) x$year, numeric(1))),
  decreasing = TRUE
)

has_value <- function(x) {
  !is.null(x) &&
    length(x) > 0 &&
    !is.na(x) &&
    nzchar(x)
}

strip_html <- function(x) {
  gsub("<[^>]+>", "", x)
}


for (yr in years) {

  cat(
    sprintf(
      '<div class="publication-year" data-year="%s">%s</div>\n',
      yr,
      yr
    )
  )

  year_pubs <- Filter(
    function(x) x$year == yr,
    pubs
  )

  for (pub in year_pubs) {

    topics <- if (!is.null(pub$topics)) {
      paste(pub$topics, collapse = " ")
    } else {
      ""
    }

    search_text <- paste(
      strip_html(pub$title),
      strip_html(pub$authors),
      pub$venue,
      pub$details,
      pub$year,
      pub$type,
      topics
    )

    # Open publication
    image_class <- if (has_value(pub$image)) {
  " publication-with-image"
} else {
  ""
}

cat(
  sprintf(
    '<article class="publication-item%s" data-type="%s" data-search="%s">',
    image_class,
    pub$type,
    tolower(search_text)
  )
)

    # Image
    if (has_value(pub$image)) {
      cat(
        sprintf(
          '<div class="publication-thumb"><img src="%s" alt=""></div>',
          pub$image
        )
      )
    }

    # Content
    cat('<div class="publication-content">')

    # Title
    cat(
      sprintf(
        '<div class="publication-title">%s</div>',
        pub$title
      )
    )

    # Authors
    cat(
      sprintf(
        '<div class="publication-authors">%s</div>',
        pub$authors
      )
    )

    # Venue
    details <- if (has_value(pub$details)) {
      paste0(" · ", pub$details)
    } else {
      ""
    }

    cat(
      sprintf(
        '<div class="publication-venue"><em>%s</em>%s</div>',
        pub$venue,
        details
      )
    )

    # Links
    cat('<div class="publication-links">')

    if (has_value(pub$publisher)) {
      cat(
        sprintf(
          '<a href="%s" target="_blank"><i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right"></i> Publisher</a>',
          pub$publisher
        )
      )
    }

    if (has_value(pub$researchgate)) {
      cat(
        sprintf(
          '<a href="%s" target="_blank"><i class="ai ai-researchgate"></i> ResearchGate</a>',
          pub$researchgate
        )
      )
    }

    if (has_value(pub$pdf)) {
      cat(
        sprintf(
          '<a href="%s" target="_blank"><i class="bi bi-file-earmark-pdf"></i> PDF</a>',
          pub$pdf
        )
      )
    }

    if (has_value(pub$code)) {
      cat(
        sprintf(
          '<a href="%s" target="_blank"><i class="bi bi-github"></i> Code</a>',
          pub$code
        )
      )
    }
    
    if (has_value(pub$supplement)) {
  cat(
    sprintf(
      '<a href="%s" target="_blank"><i class="bi bi-paperclip"></i> Supplement</a>',
      pub$supplement
    )
  )
}

    cat('</div>')  # publication-links
    cat('</div>')  # publication-content
    cat('</article>\n')

  }
}
```


<script>

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  const search = document.getElementById("publication-search");
  const typeFilter = document.getElementById("publication-type");
  const publications = document.querySelectorAll(".publication-item");
  const years = document.querySelectorAll(".publication-year");
  const count = document.getElementById("publication-count");


  function filterPublications() {

    const query = search.value.toLowerCase().trim();
    const type = typeFilter.value;

    let visible = 0;


    publications.forEach(function (publication) {

      const text = publication.dataset.search;
      const publicationType = publication.dataset.type;

      const matchesSearch =
        text.includes(query);

      const matchesType =
        type === "all" ||
        publicationType === type;

      const show =
        matchesSearch && matchesType;

      publication.style.display =
        show ? "" : "none";

      if (show) visible++;

    });


    years.forEach(function (year) {

      let next = year.nextElementSibling;
      let hasVisible = false;

      while (
        next &&
        !next.classList.contains("publication-year")
      ) {

        if (
          next.classList.contains("publication-item") &&
          next.style.display !== "none"
        ) {
          hasVisible = true;
        }

        next = next.nextElementSibling;
      }

      year.style.display =
        hasVisible ? "" : "none";

    });


    count.textContent =
      visible +
      (visible === 1
        ? " publication"
        : " publications");

  }


  search.addEventListener(
    "input",
    filterPublications
  );

  typeFilter.addEventListener(
    "change",
    filterPublications
  );


  filterPublications();

});

</script>
